analyses.groupDescription:
Control for multiplicity was accomplished through the a fixed-sequence testing procedure for Week 6 outcomes:

* AIMS dyskinesia total score mean change from baseline (CFB): valbenazine 80 mg vs. placebo.
* CGI-TD mean score: VBZ 80 mg vs. PBO.
* AIMS: VBZ 40 mg vs. PBO.
* CGI-TD: VBZ 40 mg vs. PBO.

For a test result in the above list to be considered statistically significant, all of the test results higher in the list must have been significant at the 0.05 level of significance.

analyses.pValueComment: Nominal P-value, not adjusted for multiplicity. See comments in above statistical analysis overview regarding the fixed-sequence testing procedure to control for multiplicity.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Severity of TD symptoms assessed by AIMS dyskinesia total score (sum of items 1 through 7), as assessed by blinded central AIMS video raters. The AIMS Total Dyskinesia Score rates a total of 7 items, rating involuntary movement from 0 (no dyskinesia) to 4 (severe dyskinesia). Items 1 through 7 include facial and oral movements (Items 1-4), extremity movements (Items 5-6), and trunk movements (Item 7). The AIMS dyskinesia total score for Items 1-7 ranges from 0 to 28; a higher score reflects increased severity.

groups.description: Participants received Placebo capsule (matching valbenazine capsules) once daily for 6 weeks.
groups.title: Placebo

groups.description: Participants received valbenazine 40mg capsule once daily for 1 week, then 80mg capsule once daily for 5 weeks.
groups.title: Valbenazine 80mg

groups.description: Participants received valbenazine 40mg capsule once daily for 6 weeks.
groups.title: Valbenazine 40mg

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Intent to treat (ITT) analysis set (all subjects in the safety analysis set who have a baseline (Day -1) AIMS dyskinesia total score value and at least one post-randomization AIMS dyskinesia total score value reported during the placebo-controlled treatment period).
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Abnormal Involuntary Movement Scale (AIMS) Dyskinesia Total Score Change From Baseline at Week 6
